newsitem.title: USA: Latin American Casinos to go to Nicaragua.
newsitem.headline: Latin American Casinos to go to Nicaragua.

text.p: Latin American Casinos Inc said Wednesday the company will begin slot parlor operations in Nicaragua by year end.
This is the first Central American country the company has expanded into, the company said. The company rents used slot machines to local business people who operate storefront parlors.
The company said it expects to have a minimum of 500 slot machines in operation in Nicaragua and plans to expand into other Central American countries in the future.
